title: TableColumn
description:
One column header of a `Table`.

Carries the header text and how the column is laid out. The first column of a table is
significant beyond presentation: when its `name` is a dice formula such as `"d100"`, the
table matches rolls against ranges in that column rather than by row position.

- SeeAlso: `Table`

name.description:
The column header text.

## Examples
- `"d100"` — marks the first column as holding result ranges
- `"Magic Item"`

alignment.description:
How cells in this column are aligned, as the raw value of an `Alignment`.

Use `alignmentValue` for the typed form. A `nil` value falls back to centered for
formula columns and leading otherwise.

## Examples
- `"left"`, `"right"`, `"center"`

size.description:
The column's width.

Interpreted by magnitude: `0` means size to content, a value up to `1` is a fraction of
the table width, and anything larger is an absolute width in points.

## Examples
- `0` — dynamic
- `0.25` — a quarter of the table
- `120` — 120 points

- SeeAlso: `sizeTitle(for:)`

Alignment.title: Alignment
Alignment.description: How cells in a `TableColumn` are aligned.
